Description: Media uploads fail after the shared volume reaches its capacity threshold; investigation identified stale temporary artifacts.
Solution: Remove confirmed obsolete temporary files, verify retention requirements, and increase the affected volume if sustained capacity requires it.
description: Storage Capacity Alert - Media uploads fail after the shared volume reaches its capacity threshold; investigation identified stale temporary artifacts.
resolution_notes: Remove confirmed obsolete temporary files, verify retention requirements, and increase the affected volume if sustained capacity requires it.

Description: Media pages load slowly while edge requests repeatedly miss the cdn cache; investigation identified an expired cache entry.
Solution: Purge the affected CDN path, confirm the origin response is healthy, and verify that subsequent requests are served from cache.
description: Media Delivery Latency - Media pages load slowly while edge requests repeatedly miss the cdn cache; investigation identified an expired cache entry.
resolution_notes: Purge the affected CDN path, confirm the origin response is healthy, and verify that subsequent requests are served from cache.

Description: Multiple failed sign-in attempts target media administration accounts from unfamiliar addresses; investigation identified a stale service credential.
Solution: Review the authentication audit trail, block confirmed malicious sources, and require MFA for affected privileged accounts.
description: Suspicious Login Attempts - Multiple failed sign-in attempts target media administration accounts from unfamiliar addresses; investigation identified a stale service credential.
resolution_notes: Review the authentication audit trail, block confirmed malicious sources, and require MFA for affected privileged accounts.

Description: Processing workers sustain high cpu usage and media jobs complete more slowly; investigation identified a resource-heavy processing profile.
Solution: Compare resource use by worker and job type, then tune the processing concurrency within the service capacity limits.
description: Worker CPU Saturation - Processing workers sustain high cpu usage and media jobs complete more slowly; investigation identified a resource-heavy processing profile.
resolution_notes: Compare resource use by worker and job type, then tune the processing concurrency within the service capacity limits.

Description: Catalog searches time out while metadata indexing is running; investigation identified a missing query index.
Solution: Review the query plan and current index coverage, then apply an index change only after validating it in staging.
description: Catalog Query Timeout - Catalog searches time out while metadata indexing is running; investigation identified a missing query index.
resolution_notes: Review the query plan and current index coverage, then apply an index change only after validating it in staging.

Description: A media host reports repeated disk controller resets during file access; investigation identified a degraded device.
Solution: Collect controller health logs and schedule a replacement for the confirmed failing component under the hardware support plan.
description: Disk Controller Warning - A media host reports repeated disk controller resets during file access; investigation identified a degraded device.
resolution_notes: Collect controller health logs and schedule a replacement for the confirmed failing component under the hardware support plan.
